name: Glue Trap Live Resin All-in-One Device | 1g
description: Glue Trap is a strain created by crossing Gorilla Glue #4 x Guard Dawg. This strain features dominant terpenes—β-Caryophyllene, β-Myrcene and δ-Limonene—delivering a bold, terpene-rich flavor profile layered with notes of Cinnamon, Hops, Orange, Pine, Magnolia and Chamomile. Crafted with proprietary zero heat solvent removal process, this formulation is 100% Live resin. This All-in-One device is built for a smooth, full-bodied live resin experience: flavor-forward, satisfying, and consistent from the first pull to the last. Designed for real-life convenience, it’s pre-charged and ready to use, making it an easy go-to for elevated, on-the-go sessions.
